character: Fictional AI-generated child; no user photo supplied.
artifactType: Static visual samples; expressions are illustrative and are not implemented by the app.

designRules.medium: Warm gouache / cut-paper collage with photographic head and illustrated rounded body.
designRules.emotion: Eyes and action attend to the story. Quiet care, excited catching, then puzzled searching; do not default every page to smiling at the camera.
designRules.photoIdentity: The user's face and complete original hairstyle remain source pixels. Do not replace hair with template hair, crop crown/tails, stretch the face, or invent a new face.
designRules.sizing: Calibrate head proportions using facial landmarks, with extra room for long hair and braids; do not shrink the face merely to fit a larger hairstyle.
designRules.compositing: Separate photo and illustration layers. Use a consistent chin anchor, suitable pose, collar contact shadow and deliberate front/back hair occlusion. Keep originals unchanged.
designRules.expressionPolicy: Single-photo runtime preserves the supplied expression. Body pose, framing and a small question mark can express searching. Exact additional facial expressions require suitable extra photos or a separately designed identity-preserving feature; never imply the current app changes expression.
designRules.longHairAcceptance: Long hair, tied hair, braids and hair accessories require dedicated extraction and composition validation before declaring the photo integration complete.
designRules.countContinuity: Page 1 has 11 petals, page 3 has 7 attached plus 4 airborne, page 6 has none visible.
